::: {.obsidian-contract}
:::

# Confidential information

Define what counts as confidential information. Include written and
oral disclosure, and name any excluded information.

# Obligations

State what each party must do with the information. Name the
permitted purpose, the care standard, and who inside each party may
see the information.

# Term and return

State how long the obligations last and what happens to the
information at the end. Name the return or destruction duty.

# General

Record the remaining boilerplate: no licence grant, no warranty,
assignment, and notices.
